_om: Meyer in English (Mia, rusj.no/en/mia/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Ny runde – du begynner og kan si hva du: New round – you start and can call anything.
{navn} trodde på det. Ingen mister liv –: {navn} believed it. Nobody loses a life – new round.
{navn} loses one life without lifting the cup.
Den høyeste terningen sies først: 4 og 6: The higher die is said first: 4 and 6 is 64. Equal rolls are equally good, whichever die shows what.
Høyest. Løftes den, mister taperen to li: Highest. If the cup is lifted, the loser loses two lives
Så parene, seksere til enere: Then the doubles, sixes down to ones
Så resten, høyeste terning først: Then the rest, higher die first
Slår du 3-2, kan du si «Fellesrunde» – n: Roll 3-2 and you can call ‘Truce’ – at any point in the round. If the next player believes it, nobody loses a life and a new round begins. It can be a bluff too – and then the cup can be lifted.
Rist begeret, kikk i hemmelighet og si e: Shake the cup, peek in secret and call a roll that beats the last one – true or a bluff. Whoever's wrong loses a life.
Rist begeret og hold fingeren på kortet: Shake the cup and hold your finger on the card to see the dice. Only you can see them.
Velg hva du sier fra lista. Det kan være: Pick your call from the list. It can be true – or a bluff. Then the phone moves on.
Neste tror det (og må slå det) eller rop: The next player believes it (and must beat it) or shouts ‘Liar!’. Then the cup is lifted: if you were wrong, you lose a life. The last one with lives left wins.
Det er sant hvis terningene viser det so: It counts as true if the dice show what was called – or better.
Etter Meyer kan ingen slå det: løft (tap: After Mia, nobody can beat it: lift the cup (the loser loses two lives) or accept Mia and lose one.
Taperen begynner neste runde. Alle har s: The loser starts the next round. Everyone has six lives – the die by each name shows how many are left.
Når du tror på det forrige, slår du nye: When you believe the last call, you roll new dice. You don't have to peek before you call.
Hvor mange spillere mobilen er: How many players the phone plays
tror på det meste og bløffer vilt: believes most things and bluffs wildly
regner litt og bløffer av og til: does a few sums and bluffs now and then
regner på sjansene og er vanskelig å lur: works out the odds and is hard to fool
Få nok? Legg til spillere som mobilen st: Not enough of you? Add players the phone controls.
{navn} tror det. Fellesrunde – ingen mis: {navn} believes it. Truce – nobody loses a life.
Shake, peek – and call something higher.
Send mobilen videre når du har sagt ditt: Pass the phone on once you've made your call.
On your own? Play against the phone.
Hvor mange liv hver spiller har: How many lives each player has
Slår du 3-2, kan du si «Fellesrunde»: in: Roll 3-2 and you can call ‘Truce’: nobody loses a life and the round starts again.
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se: Hold your finger on the card to see
Under begeret. Hold fingeren på kortet f: Under the cup. Hold your finger on the card to see your dice
Godta Meyer og mist ett liv: Accept Mia and lose one life
Meyer kan ikke slås. Løft – taperen mist: Mia can't be beaten. Lift the cup – the loser loses two lives – or accept it and lose one.
Tror du det, mister ingen liv. Løgn? Løf: If you believe it, nobody loses a life. A lie? Lift the cup!
Tror du det, må du slå det. Tror du ikke: If you believe it, you must beat it. If you don't, shout ‘Liar!’.
Mobilen vant denne gangen. Revansj?: The phone won this time. Rematch?
Spillet ble avsluttet før det var ferdig: The game was stopped before it finished.
Kveldens bløffer: {navn} – {antall} gikk: Bluffer of the night: {navn} – {antall} got through.
Dere må være minst to. Legg til en spill: You need at least two. Add a player – or the phone.
Terningene ligger under begeret. Hold fi: The dice are under the cup. Hold your finger on the card to see.
Ingen har mistet liv ennå. Dere kan allt: Nobody has lost a life yet. You can always start a new one.
Dere går rett til kåringen. Flest liv ig: You'll go straight to the results. Most lives left leads.
